content:
### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Container:** Centered modal dialog, approx. **[206, 12, 782, 836]** (576px W x 824px H). Background is white with a subtle drop shadow and 6-8px border radius.
*   **Header Region:** **[206, 12, 782, 75]**. Contains a large centered icon and the close (X) button at top-right.
*   **Instructional Text Block:** Centered below header, **[335, 170, 664, 240]**.
*   **Tab Bar:** **[246, 267, 742, 309]**. Two equal-width tabs ("Local", "Cloud") with a light gray background container.
*   **List/Options Container:** **[246, 325, 742, 684]**. Light blue-gray background (`#F5F8FC` est.) containing three selectable rows.
    *   *Row 1 (Windows C:):* **[256, 333, 732, 401]**. Includes radio button, drive icon, name, stats, and warning icon.
    *   *Warning Banner:* **[256, 409, 732, 469]**. Yellow background inset within the list.
    *   *Row 2 (Temp D:):* **[256, 484, 732, 552]**.
    *   *Row 3 (Choose folder):* **[256, 579, 732, 637]**.
*   **Footer Region:** **[206, 750, 782, 836]**. Contains the "Enable file repair" toggle on the left and the "Save" action button on the right.

### 2) TEXT
*   **Window Title (in taskbar/background):** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wi...`
*   **Dialog Header:** `Choose a destination path to save the file:`
*   **Sub-header:** `You have 1139165 file(s) (146.58 GB) to recover.`
*   **Tab 1:** `Local`
*   **Tab 2:** `Cloud`
*   **Row 1 Label:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Row 1 Stats:** `31.30 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Warning Text:** `We highly recommend saving the found data to a different drive or a network drive.`
*   **Row 2 Label:** `Temporary Storage (D:)`
*   **Row 2 Stats:** `146.07 GB/150 GB`
*   **Row 3 Label:** `Choose folder...`
*   **Toggle Label:** `Enable file repair`
*   **Button:** `Save`
*   **Background Status Bar (Left):** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139165 (146.58 GB)`
*   **Background Status Bar (Right):** `Selected: 1139165 files (146.58 GB)`
*   **Background Button:** `Recover`
*   **System Time:** `6:29 PM`, `10/17/2026`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **List Container Background:** `#F4F7FB` (Light Blue-Gray)
*   **Selected Row Background:** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Warning Banner Background:** `#FFF8E1` (Pale Yellow)
*   **Primary Accent (Button/Toggle/Radio):** `#1677FF` (Bright Blue)
*   **Text Primary:** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Text Secondary/Muted:** `#666666` or `#888888` (Gray)
*   **Text Warning/Stats:** `#FF4D4F` (Red for low space/warnings)
*   **Tab Inactive Text:** `#333333`
*   **Tab Active Text:** `#000000`
*   **Tab Container BG:** `#F0F0F0`

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Header ("Choose a destination..."):** Sans-Serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~15-16px, Weight 500 (Medium).
*   **Sub-header ("You have..."):** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Weight 400, Color Gray.
*   **Tabs:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 500.
*   **Row Labels ("Windows (C:)"):** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 500.
*   **Row Stats ("31.30 GB..."):** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Weight 400, Color Red/Gray.
*   **Warning Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Weight 400, Color Dark Brown/Black.
*   **Button Text:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 500, Color White.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~24px horizontal, ~20px vertical.
*   **Row Height:** ~64px.
*   **Radio Button Size:** 20x20px diameter.
*   **Drive Icon Size:** 32x32px.
*   **Toggle Switch:** ~44px wide, 24px high.
*   **Save Button:** ~110px wide, 40px high. Border Radius: 4-6px.
*   **Gutter between Radio & Icon:** ~12px.
*   **Gutter between Icon & Text:** ~12px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Close Button (X):** Top right. State: Normal.
*   **Tab Control:**
    *   **Local:** State: **Selected** (White background, black text).
    *   **Cloud:** State: **Normal** (Gray background, dark gray text).
*   **Radio Buttons:**
    *   **Windows (C:):** State: **Selected** (Blue fill, white dot).
    *   **Temporary Storage (D:):** State: **Normal** (Empty circle).
    *   **Choose folder:** State: **Normal** (Empty circle).
*   **Toggle Switch ("Enable file repair"):** State: **ON** (Right-aligned thumb, blue track).
*   **Action Button ("Save"):** State: **Enabled** (Solid blue background, no visual disable cues).
*   **Warning Icons (Triangle !):** Red outline/fill. Present on Row 1 and Row 2.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled with subtle gradients/shading (Microsoft Fluent style).
*   **Header Icon:** Blue Folder with a document inside.
*   **Drive Icons:**
    *   Windows (C:): SSD/HDD icon with Windows logo flag.
    *   Temporary Storage (D:): Generic silver Drive icon.
    *   Choose folder: Yellow/Blue generic Folder icon.
*   **Warning Icon:** Triangle with exclamation mark (Red).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Selection/Configuration**. The user has completed a scan (background shows "Scan Completed") and is now in the "Recover" workflow, specifically choosing a destination.
*   **Specific Logic State:** **Insufficient Space / Risk Warning**.
    *   The app explicitly warns that the source drive (C:) is selected as the destination ("recommend saving... to a different drive").
    *   The red text on C: and D: drives indicates available free space is being evaluated against the recovery size (146.58 GB). C: has 31GB free (Critical), D: has 146GB free (Tight/Caution).
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
